"""Finite registration: preserve the strong original function before learning."""
from pathlib import Path
import copy,datetime,json,sys,time
import t581_runtime as R
ROOT,HERE,OUT,DOC,L=R.ROOT,R.HERE,R.OUT,R.DOC,R.L
read,save,sha,digest,torch,np=R.read,R.save,R.sha,R.digest,R.torch,R.np

def prepare():
    assert not OUT.exists();DOC.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    old=ROOT/'stage/runs/t580_meta_replay_transfer'
    assert read(old/'audit.json')['state']=='PASS' and read(old/'SEALED.json')['all_scientific_processes_stopped']
    assert all(not Path('/proc',str(i)).exists() for i in read(old/'SEALED.json')['scientific_pids'])
    assert read(ROOT/'stage/docs/long_distance_20261101/release_receipt_T580.json')['state']=='FULL_REMOTE_READBACK_AND_EVERY_MEMBER_SHA_VERIFIED'
    p=copy.deepcopy(read(old/'protocol.json'))
    for key in ['arms','blocks','inner_steps','rows_per_chunk','inner_lr','meta_gamma','batch_seed','initial_success_ids','inputs','protected_files']:
        p.pop(key,None)
    final=ROOT/'stage/runs/t550_offline_obstacle_relay/final407'
    allrows=R.G.rows(final);finalp=read(final/'protocol.json');alljobs=finalp['final_jobs']
    assert len(allrows)==len(alljobs)==407
    by={r['job_id']:r for r in allrows};base=p['neural_teacher']
    assert all(r['policy_hash']==base['policy_hash'] for r in allrows)
    chosen=list(p['evaluation_jobs']);seen={j['id'] for j in chosen}
    # Fixed, evenly spaced consumed successful IDs, four per distance family.
    for low,high in [(0,275),(275,329),(329,383)]:
        choices=[j for j in alljobs[low:high] if j['id'] not in seen and by[j['id']]['success'] and not by[j['id']]['collision']]
        picks=[choices[int(i)] for i in np.linspace(0,len(choices)-1,4,dtype=int)]
        for j in picks:chosen.append(j);seen.add(j['id'])
    assert len(chosen)==len(seen)==49
    for j in chosen:
        assert next(z for z in alljobs if z['id']==j['id'])==j
    hist=R.G.rows(ROOT/'stage/runs/t579_frozen_progress_attribution')
    baseline=[r for r in hist if r['role']=='FROZEN_T550' and r['job_id'] in ['wide117_80_dev6_LEFT_00','t502_field_sector6_offset3']]
    assert len(baseline)==2 and all(not r['success'] for r in baseline)
    target=next(j for j in chosen if j['id']=='wide117_80_dev6_LEFT_00')
    keep=p['keep_rows']+p['repair_rows'];assert len(keep)==27
    keys=['wide117_80_dev6_LEFT_00','wide117_80_dev6_RIGHT_23','wide117_8m_dev6_LEFT_13','wide117_8m_dev6_RIGHT_13']
    epoch=lambda text:datetime.datetime.fromisoformat('2026-11-16T'+text+':00+08:00').timestamp()
    p.update(id='T581_PRESERVE_T550_FUNCTION_SINGLE_RESIDUAL_RL',out=str(OUT),base_model=base,
        initial=base,keep_rows=keep,repair_rows=[],evaluation_jobs=chosen,
        baseline_jobs=[next(j for j in chosen if j['id']==r['job_id']) for r in baseline],historical_baseline=baseline,
        initial_success_ids=[j['id'] for j in chosen if by[j['id']]['success'] and not by[j['id']]['collision'] and by[j['id']]['field_detail']['field_qualified_success']],
        target_job=target,key_replay_ids=keys,residual_seed=581,residual_scale=.1,
        rl_lr=3e-5,rl_steps=8,target_kl=.01,keep_weight=100.,training_seeds=[[581,0,k] for k in range(4)],
        main_seconds=1800,learning_seconds=900,audit_seconds=480,transport_seconds=300,source_seconds=180,
        absolute_learning_stop=epoch('11:15'),absolute_native_stop=epoch('11:30'),absolute_all_stop=epoch('12:00'),
        max_commands=70,max_bytes=22*2**20,child_bytes=22*2**20,full_bytes=1280*1024,compact_bytes=12*1024,model_bytes=256*1024,
        inputs={},protected_files={},new_Actor_Adam_cap=8,shadow_Adam_cap=8,audit_discarded_Adam_cap=8,
        preflight_discarded_Adam_cap=4,new_teacher_queries=0,new_BC=0,new_Critic=0,
        independent_new_mechanism_budget_not_T580_extension=True,
        count_contract='Only explicit T581 fields apply; inherited configuration is model loading compatibility.',
        user_authorization='2026-11-16 下一步开始 after T550 exact-function residual RL plan; within12:00 cutoff',
        scope='One fresh same-policy4episode batch,one8Adam-cap proposal; expanded49consumed autonomous+key4exact; retain ALL original success IDs and gain>=1. No grid or automatic next launch.')
    p['max_physics']=sum(j['case']['step_cap'] for j in p['baseline_jobs'])+8*target['case']['step_cap']+sum(j['case']['step_cap'] for j in chosen)+sum(j['case']['step_cap'] for j in chosen if j['id'] in keys)
    assert time.time()+1800<p['absolute_native_stop'] and time.time()+900<p['absolute_learning_stop']
    assert time.time()+1800+480+300+180+30<p['absolute_all_stop']
    torch.set_num_threads(1);torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)
    obj=L.make(p);shadow=L.make(p);q=obj[0];parent=L.ORIGINAL_FROZEN(p,base['path']);body=L.fixed(q)
    data=L.references(p);assert all(torch.equal(L.loc(q,g['f'],g['base']),g['target']) for g in data)
    checks=[]
    with torch.no_grad():
        for row in keep+baseline:
            a=R.E.N.S.arrays(row['path']);x=torch.tensor(a['states'])
            assert torch.equal(q.sequence(x),parent.sequence(x))
            checks.append(dict(id=row['job_id'],decisions=len(x),initial_location_bitwise_equal=True))
        x=R.E.N.S.arrays(baseline[0]['path'])['states'][:16];h=hp=None
        for z in x:
            u,b,h,_=q.step(torch.tensor(z[None]),h);v,c,hp,_=parent.step(torch.tensor(z[None]),hp)
            assert torch.equal(u,v) and torch.equal(b,c) and torch.equal(h,hp)
        future=torch.tensor(x);changed=future.clone();changed[8:]+=1
        assert torch.equal(q.sequence(future)[:8],q.sequence(changed)[:8])
    aa=[]
    for seed in range(4):
        q.sample=True;q.rng=np.random.default_rng(581+seed);q.reset_noise();h=None;locations=[];tapes=[]
        with torch.no_grad():
            for z in x:
                u,b,h,_=q.step(torch.tensor(z[None]),h);locations.append(b[0].numpy().copy());tapes.append(q.tape[-1])
        flags=np.zeros((len(x),3),np.uint8);flags[-1,2]=1
        aa.append(dict(states=x.copy(),next_states=np.r_[x[1:],x[-1:]],locations=np.asarray(locations),
            raw_actions=np.asarray([t['raw_actions'] for t in tapes]),atom=np.asarray([t['atom'] for t in tapes]),
            logp=np.asarray([t['logp'] for t in tapes]),ownership=np.zeros(len(x),np.uint8),stochastic=np.ones(len(x),np.uint8),
            end_flags=flags,native_counts=np.full(len(x),100,np.int64),rewards=np.linspace(-.001,.001,len(x))*(1+.2*seed)))
    before=L.state(obj);u=L.fit(obj,aa,data,p,lambda:None,lambda *_:None,steps=2)
    v=L.fit(shadow,aa,data,p,lambda:None,lambda *_:None,steps=2)
    assert u==v and digest(L.state(obj))==digest(L.state(shadow)) and u['Actor_Adam']==2 and L.fixed(q)==body
    assert any(t['gradient_norm']>0 for t in u['trace'])
    mature=L.state(obj);L.load(obj,before);assert digest(L.state(obj))==digest(before)
    L.load(obj,mature);assert digest(L.state(obj))==digest(mature)
    temp=DOC/'discarded_checkpoint.pt.gz';m=L.export(obj,p,temp);assert L.frozen(p,temp).phash()==q.phash();temp.unlink()
    full=R.E.N.S.arrays(ROOT/'stage/runs/t577_offline_recovery_night/rl_04_round/episodes/full_0.npz')
    temp=DOC/'discarded_codec.npz';R.E.N.write_npz(temp,full,p['full_bytes']);codec=temp.stat().st_size;temp.unlink()
    upper=10*p['full_bytes']+45*p['compact_bytes']+2*p['model_bytes']+8*2**20
    assert upper<=p['max_bytes'] and R.used(ROOT/'stage/runs')+p['max_bytes']+131072<2**30
    save(DOC/'PREFLIGHT.json',dict(state='PASS_ZERO_NATIVE',new_native=0,new_navigation_Adam=0,
        synthetic_discarded_Adam=4,initial29_history_function_bitwise_equal=checks,
        same_step_action_hidden_density_verified=True,future_causality=True,initial_keep_loss_exact_zero=True,
        live_shadow_and_mature_ActorAdam_rollback_exact=True,synthetic_current_policy_credit=u['peer_batch'],
        synthetic_control_NOT_navigation_success=True,checkpoint_bytes=m['bytes'],codec_max_seen_bytes=codec,
        own_storage_upper=upper,global_worst=R.used(ROOT/'stage/runs')+p['max_bytes']+131072))
    for mod in list(sys.modules.values()):
        f=getattr(mod,'__file__',None)
        if f and str(f).startswith(str(ROOT)) and str(f).endswith('.py'):p['inputs'][str(Path(f).resolve())]=sha(f)
    for f in [*HERE.glob('*.py'),DOC/'PLAN.md',DOC/'SOURCES.md',DOC/'PREFLIGHT.json',Path(p['actor_configuration']),old/'audit.json']+[Path(r['path']) for r in keep+baseline]:p['inputs'][str(f)]=sha(f)
    for model in [base,base['parent'],base['parent']['parent']]:
        assert sha(model['path'])==model['sha256'];p['inputs'][model['path']]=model['sha256'];p['protected_files'][model['path']]=model['sha256']
    for j in chosen:p['inputs'][j['exact_snapshot']]=sha(j['exact_snapshot'])
    OUT.mkdir();blob=json.dumps(p,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False)+'\n'
    (HERE/'protocol.json').write_text(blob);(OUT/'protocol.json').write_text(blob);R.verify(p,True)
    save(DOC/'BUDGET.json',dict(state='REGISTERED_NOT_LAUNCHED',max_physics=p['max_physics'],max_commands=70,actual_worst_commands=67,
        live_Actor_Adam_cap=8,shadow_Adam_cap=8,audit_historical_Adam_cap=8,preflight_discarded_Adam=4,
        same_initial_success_count=len(p['initial_success_ids']),evaluations=49,training_unique=4,exact_replays=8,
        historical_physical_repeats=2,own_bytes=p['max_bytes'],full10_compact45=True,main_seconds=1800,audit_seconds=480,
        learning_stop='11:15',native_stop='11:30',all_stop='2026-11-16 12:00+08:00'))
    print('T581_PREFLIGHT_REGISTERED_NOT_LAUNCHED',p['max_physics'],len(p['initial_success_ids']),flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':prepare()

"""One independent frozen diagnostic, audit, manifest and bounded finalization."""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import traceback
import t581_runtime as R

ROOT,HERE,OUT,DOC,read,save,sha=R.ROOT,R.HERE,R.OUT,R.DOC,R.read,R.save,R.sha


def main():
    p=read(OUT/'protocol.json');R.verify(p,True)
    assert not (OUT/'launch.json').exists()
    start=time.time();end=p['absolute_all_stop']
    assert start+p['main_seconds']+p['audit_seconds']+p['transport_seconds']+p['source_seconds']+30<end
    receipt=read(ROOT/'stage/runs/t224_archive/latest_source_sync_receipt.json')
    assert receipt['root_tree']==subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()
    save(OUT/'launch.json',dict(pid=os.getpid(),epoch=start,source_remote=receipt['remote_commit'],
        root_tree=receipt['root_tree'],protocol_sha256=sha(OUT/'protocol.json'),
        all_stop=end,CPU=[14,15],CPUQuota='200%',GPU=False,new_Adam_cap=8,new_RL_cap=8))
    ids=[];error=None
    def call(action,cap):
        with (OUT/(action+'.log')).open('xb') as log:
            c=subprocess.Popen(['taskset','-c','14,15',str(ROOT/'run_stage.sh'),str(HERE/'t581_runtime.py'),action],cwd=ROOT,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
            ids.append(c.pid);save(DOC/'STATUS.json',dict(state=action,pid=c.pid,driver_pid=os.getpid(),epoch=time.time()))
            try:c.wait(timeout=cap);assert c.returncode==0,(action,c.returncode)
            except BaseException:
                try:os.killpg(c.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
                except ProcessLookupError:pass
                try:c.wait(timeout=2)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(c.pid,signal.SIGKILL);c.wait()
                raise
    try:
        call('main',p['main_seconds']);ids+=R.G.stopped(OUT)
        call('audit',p['audit_seconds']);assert read(OUT/'audit.json')['state']=='PASS'
        files=sorted(f for f in OUT.rglob('*') if f.is_file() and f.name not in ['driver.log','local_manifest.json'] and f.suffix not in ['.pyc','.lock'])
        members=[dict(path=str(f.relative_to(ROOT)),sha256=sha(f),bytes=f.stat().st_size) for f in files]
        save(OUT/'local_manifest.json',dict(state='SEALED_LOCAL_ALL_MEMBER_SHA',files=members))
        assert all(sha(ROOT/r['path'])==r['sha256'] for r in members)
    except BaseException:
        error=traceback.format_exc();save(DOC/'DRIVER_ERROR.json',dict(error=error,epoch=time.time(),no_restart=True))
    gone=all(not Path('/proc',str(pid)).exists() for pid in ids)
    save(OUT/'SEALED.json',dict(all_scientific_processes_stopped=gone,scientific_pids=ids,epoch=time.time()))
    report=dict(state='COMPLETE' if error is None else 'FAILED',error=error,
        summary=read(OUT/'summary.json') if (OUT/'summary.json').exists() else None,
        all_scientific_processes_stopped=gone,new_Adam_cap=8,new_RL_cap=8,remote='PENDING',
        neural_residual_RL_pilot=True,no_global_model_promotion=True,epoch=time.time())
    save(DOC/'FINAL_REPORT.json',report)
    if gone and time.time()+p['transport_seconds']+p['source_seconds']+20<end:
        try:
            c=subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','14',str(ROOT/'run_stage.sh'),str(HERE/'transport.py'),'T581'],cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,timeout=p['transport_seconds'])
            assert c.returncode==0,c.stdout.decode(errors='replace')[-1000:]+c.stderr.decode(errors='replace')[-1000:]
            report['remote']=read(ROOT/'stage/docs/long_distance_20261101/release_receipt_T581.json')['state']
        except BaseException:save(DOC/'REMOTE_PENDING.json',dict(error=traceback.format_exc(),epoch=time.time()))
    save(DOC/'FINAL_REPORT.json',report)
    text='T581保留T550原函数的单次残差RL结束：'+report['state']+'；真实训练/保留回退见summary；remote='+report['remote']+'。不称完整407或泛化通过。\n'
    (DOC/'FINAL_REPORT.md').write_text(text)
    status=ROOT/'stage/docs/RESEARCH_STATUS.md';status.write_text('2026-11-16 '+text+'\n'+status.read_text())
    try:
        paths=[str(DOC.relative_to(ROOT)),'stage/docs/RESEARCH_STATUS.md']
        for name in ['source_manifest_T581.json','release_receipt_T581.json']:
            f=ROOT/'stage/docs/long_distance_20261101'/name
            if f.exists():paths.append(str(f.relative_to(ROOT)))
        subprocess.run(['git','add','--',*paths],cwd=ROOT,check=True,capture_output=True)
        subprocess.run(['git','commit','-m','Report T581 fixed frozen progress attribution'],cwd=ROOT,check=True,capture_output=True)
        if time.time()+p['source_seconds']+5<end:
            c=subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','14',str(ROOT/'run_stage.sh'),str(HERE/'transport.py'),'source_sync'],cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,timeout=p['source_seconds'])
            assert c.returncode==0
    except BaseException:save(DOC/'SOURCE_PENDING.json',dict(error=traceback.format_exc(),epoch=time.time()))


if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Three predeclared matched transfer updates followed by autonomous development."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import os
import shutil
import sys
import time
import traceback
import t581_learning as L

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3];HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUT=ROOT/'stage/runs/t581_preserved_t550_rl';DOC=ROOT/'stage/docs/day_20261116/t581'
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'stage/experiments/t577_offline_recovery_night'))
import t577_runtime as R
read,save,sha,digest,torch,np=L.read,L.save,L.sha,L.digest,L.torch,L.np
Base,F,G,E,P=R.Base,R.F,R.G,R.E,R.P


def used(path):return sum(f.stat().st_size for f in Path(path).rglob('*') if f.is_file())


def verify(p,full=False):
    root=read(OUT/'protocol.json');assert sha(HERE/'protocol.json')==sha(OUT/'protocol.json')
    assert time.time()<root['absolute_all_stop'] and used(OUT)<=root['max_bytes']
    assert used(ROOT/'stage/runs')-used(OUT)+root['max_bytes']+131072<2**30
    assert shutil.disk_usage(ROOT).free>=40*2**30
    assert os.environ.get('CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES')=='' and not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
    assert set(os.sched_getaffinity(0))<={14,15}
    for f,h in (root['inputs'] if full else root['protected_files']).items():assert sha(f)==h,f


def setup():
    R.HERE=HERE;R.verify=verify;R.L.frozen=L.frozen;R.setup(OUT);Base.verify=verify;P.frozen=L.frozen


def worker(pipe,index,p,counts):
    R.L.frozen=L.frozen;R.worker(pipe,index,p,counts)


class Pool(R.Pool):
    def __init__(self,p,counts,guard):
        self.p=p;self.guard,self.children,self.pipes=guard,[],[];ctx=G.R.M.mp.get_context('spawn')
        try:
            for i in range(2):
                a,b=ctx.Pipe();c=ctx.Process(target=worker,args=(b,i,p,counts));c.start();b.close();self.children.append(c);self.pipes.append(a)
            self.ready=[self.receive(i) for i in range(2)];assert all(x['state']=='READY' for x in self.ready)
            save(OUT/'worker_generations.json',[dict(parent=os.getpid(),workers=[c.pid for c in self.children],epoch=time.time(),CPU=[14,15],GPU=False)])
        except BaseException:self.close();raise



def assess(p,rows):
    assert len(rows)==len(p['evaluation_jobs'])==49
    assert [r['job_id'] for r in rows]==[j['id'] for j in p['evaluation_jobs']]
    ids={r['job_id'] for r in rows if r['success'] and not r['collision'] and r['field_detail']['field_qualified_success']}
    prior=set(p['initial_success_ids']);return dict(success=len(ids),valid=49,
        contact=sum(r['collision'] for r in rows),timeout=sum(r['timeout'] for r in rows),
        success_ids=sorted(ids),lost_initial=sorted(prior-ids),gained=sorted(ids-prior),
        accepted=prior<=ids and len(ids)>len(prior),full407=None,fresh16=None,reload78=None,
        finite_development_NOT_global_retention=True)


def progress(r,a):
    dt=a['native_counts'].astype(float)*.002
    ds=np.linalg.norm(a['next_poses'][:,:2]-a['poses'][:,:2],axis=1)
    return dict(role=r['role'],job_id=r['job_id'],policy_hash=r['policy_hash'],
        success=r['success'],remaining_m=r['remaining_m'],seconds=float(dt.sum()),
        mean_endpoint_speed_m_s=float(ds.sum()/dt.sum()),full_pose_saved=r['full'],array_digest=r['array_digest'])


def check_history(p,vals):
    for a,r in vals:
        F.M.audit_full_history(p,r,a);Base.append('progress.jsonl',progress(r,a))


def main():
    p=read(OUT/'protocol.json');setup();verify(p,True);E.N.offline();E.L.install_stop_handlers()
    rt=Base.Runtime(p);state='FAILED';error=None;result=None;obj=shadow=before=None
    try:
        obj=L.make(p);shadow=L.make(p);before=L.state(obj);data=L.references(p)
        assert all(float((L.loc(obj[0],g['f'],g['base'])-g['target']).abs().max())==0 for g in data)
        behavior=L.export(obj,p,OUT/'initial.pt.gz')
        assert L.frozen(p,behavior['path']).phash()==obj[0].phash()
        rt.pool=Pool(dict(p,phase='student',native_stop_epoch=rt.deadline),rt.counts,rt.guard)
        vals=rt.request(p['baseline_jobs'],behavior,'ZERO_RESIDUAL_T550_NATIVE_EQUIVALENCE',full=True)
        check_history(p,vals)
        for a,r in vals:
            old=next(v for v in p['historical_baseline'] if v['job_id']==r['job_id'])
            assert r['array_hashes']==old['array_hashes'] and r['integration_sha256']==old['integration_sha256']
        save(OUT/'INITIAL_FUNCTION_NATIVE_PASS.json',dict(two_exact_T579_histories=True,new_independent_samples=False))
        vals=rt.request([p['target_job']]*4,behavior,'FRESH_T550_RESIDUAL_POLICY_TRAIN',seeds=p['training_seeds'],full=True)
        check_history(p,vals);training=[r for a,r in vals]
        rt.request([p['target_job']]*4,behavior,'EXACT_FRESH_TRAIN',seeds=p['training_seeds'],full=True,reference=training)
        arrays=[E.N.S.arrays(r['path']) for r in training]
        rt.role='ONE_CURRENT_POLICY_RL_UPDATE'
        event=lambda w:(lambda t,k:Base.append('optimizer_calls.jsonl',[w,t,k]))
        u=L.fit(obj,arrays,data,p,lambda:rt.guard(True),event('live'))
        v=L.fit(shadow,arrays,data,p,lambda:rt.guard(True),event('shadow'))
        assert u==v and digest(L.state(obj))==digest(L.state(shadow))
        proposal=L.export(obj,p,OUT/'proposal.pt.gz')
        assert L.frozen(p,proposal['path']).phash()==obj[0].phash()
        save(OUT/'LEARNING_COMPLETE.json',dict(epoch=time.time(),stop=p['absolute_learning_stop']))
        keys=[j for j in p['evaluation_jobs'] if j['id'] in p['key_replay_ids']]
        others=[j for j in p['evaluation_jobs'] if j['id'] not in p['key_replay_ids']]
        vals=rt.request(keys,proposal,'PURE_STUDENT_ALL49',full=True);keyrows=[r for a,r in vals]
        vals+=rt.request(others,proposal,'PURE_STUDENT_ALL49');check_history(p,vals)
        by={r['job_id']:r for a,r in vals};rows=[by[j['id']] for j in p['evaluation_jobs']]
        rt.request(keys,proposal,'EXACT_KEY4',full=True,reference=keyrows)
        check=assess(p,rows)
        if not check['accepted']:
            for z in [obj,shadow]:L.load(z,before)
        result=dict(update=u,behavior=behavior,proposal=proposal,check=check,training=G.R.M.tally(training),
            retained_joint_hash=digest(L.state(obj)),model=proposal if check['accepted'] else p['base_model'],
            accepted=check['accepted'],new_Actor_Adam=u['Actor_Adam'],shadow_Actor_Adam=v['Actor_Adam'],
            teacher_queries=0,BC=0,Critic=0,full407=None,fresh16=None,reload78=None,globally_promoted=False)
        state='COMPLETE'
    except BaseException:
        error=traceback.format_exc()
        if before is not None:
            for z in [obj,shadow]:L.load(z,before)
        save(OUT/'failure.json',dict(error=error,no_restart=True,raw_preserved=True,whole_ActorAdam_rollback=before is not None))
    finally:

    assert state=='COMPLETE',error


def audit():

"""RAM-only archive after every science writer is stopped; no training imports."""
from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
import json
import sys
import time

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
OUT=ROOT/'stage/runs/t581_meta_replay_transfer'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('_t581_archive',ROOT/'stage/experiments/t493_wide8_night/transport.py')
A=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(A)


def stopped():
    j=json.loads((OUT/'SEALED.json').read_text())
    assert j['all_scientific_processes_stopped']
    assert all(not Path('/proc',str(i)).exists() for i in j['scientific_pids'])


def main():
    A.OLD.install();T=A.OLD.T
    if sys.argv[1]=='source_sync':
        import sync_source
        sync_source.main();return
    assert sys.argv[1]=='T581';stopped();A.stopped=stopped
    original=T.B.write
    def write(path,value):
        if Path(path).name=='source_manifest_T581.json':
            value=dict(value,scope='Ended Stage T581 preserved T550 neural residual RL pilot')
        return original(path,value)
    T.B.write=write
    p=json.loads((OUT/'protocol.json').read_text())
    release=T.B.api('GET','releases/tags/stage-eight-only-2026-11-11')
    files=sorted(f for f in OUT.rglob('*') if f.is_file() and f.name!='driver.log' and f.suffix not in ['.lock','.pyc','.partial'])
    deadline=min(time.time()+p['transport_seconds']-10,p['absolute_all_stop']-30)
    r=A.archive('T581',files,release,deadline,T)
    stopped();assert r['state']=='FULL_REMOTE_READBACK_AND_EVERY_MEMBER_SHA_VERIFIED'
    print('T581_FULL_RAW_BACKUP_PASS',flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':main()
